We're hiring 📢
I'm building my team at Orchids The International School and we're looking for a Parent Relationship Manager in Bengaluru.

If you enjoy working with people, communicate well, and want to build a career in the education sector, this one is worth a look.

What we're looking for:
→ Any graduate – freshers as well as experienced candidates are welcome
→ Excellent English communication
→ Comfortable in a parent-facing role
→ Based in Bengaluru

Compensation will be discussed basis your profile, education and experience. Immediate joining. On-site role.
If this sounds like you – or if someone in your network is looking – apply through the link below or drop me a message directly. I'm reviewing profiles myself.

A like or a repost would go a long way. It might reach exactly the right person.

#Hiring #Bengaluru #Jobs #EducationJobs #NowHiring #Freshers #ExperiencedProfessionals #school #Bangalore #growth #jobsearch
